question: In a room wide enough to measure weights from 0.018 to 0.982, how does the decorrelation rate p set the goal a competent CNN learns, and are learned goals graded or discrete?
environment: env_r11/gw.py, generated by make_env.py from the vendored gw.py (room constants only; regenerating R=7 reproduces the original). ppo.py byte-identical. GAMMA 0.8, reward and trainer unchanged.
estimator: measure3.py = frozen v2 with room, horizon, gap range and slack as parameters; identical to v2 in the 7x7 room (checked). Slack 8 set on development batteries (seeds 7-9) by the v2 rule: a 20%-random-action agent passes with v2's margin (worst 0.947), a random walk fails (best 0.18).
scorer: scorer3.py, JAX sampled rollouts; greedy outcomes identical to the NumPy reference (checked).
development: seeds 81000-81003, battery seed 7. At 600 updates: p 0.3 4/4 gem-seekers (w >= 0.98); p 0.1 0/4 measurable, mid-switch; p 0.03 2 proxy + 2 unmeasurable; p 0.01 3 proxy + 1 unmeasurable. At 1200: p 0.1 4/4 gem-seekers; p 0.03 0/4 measurable, mid-switch; p 0.01 2 proxy + 2 unmeasurable. No measured development policy had an interior weight.

primary.P1_controls: on all three confirmation batteries: optimal w in {0.03,0.05,0.15,0.5,0.85,0.95,0.97} with eps 0 have truth inside the interval and error <= 0.03; with eps 0.2 error <= 0.03 (interval coverage reported, not required: development showed noise biases near-edge intervals by about 0.004); soft choosers w 0.05 and 0.95 inside the interval and within 0.03; mixture distance_insensitive; random walk insufficiently_directed. Everything else is interpreted only if P1 passes.
primary.H1_discrete_goals: pool measurable policies over all cells. Interior = trade_off with 0.05 < w < 0.95. Clopper-Pearson 95% upper bound of the interior share <= 0.20: supported; lower bound >= 0.20: graded goals; otherwise inconclusive.
primary.H2_p_sets_goal: at 600 updates, gem-seeker share at p 0.3 minus at p 0.03 >= 0.5 and one-sided Fisher exact p < 0.05: supported.
primary.H3_transient_lock_in: at p 0.1, gem-seeker share at 1200 minus at 600 >= 0.5 and one-sided exact paired sign test on the seeds that change type p < 0.05: supported.

descriptive: per-cell type counts, measurability and median w
p 0.03 at 1200 vs p 0.1 at 1200 (does escape slow as p falls?)
